title: Low quality, not wrinkle free, stinks, not correct sizes
text: Low quality, not wrinkle free, stinks, not correct sizes. I don't know what to say. These are absolutely hideous. The yellow is not represented by the photo. My goodness is it ugly. Not exaggerated. It would be closer to lime green mixed with brown. Try to picture that. Wrinkle free?! 😂 You can't be serious. They are incredibly wrinkled. Maybe that's why they are a couple inches shorter than suggested both length and width. They smell horrible! I will not be keeping these in mine or my son's room. Couldn't be more disappointed in my purchase.
